chapterNotes.text: Since this recording, machines join over SpecWithCode Connect using Join one of your machines and a one-time six-character device approval code, without join lines or Tailscale setup.

chapterNotes.text: This chapter predates the current advice: keep each machine signed in to one account per provider, and add a machine for more capacity instead of switching subscriptions on one.
